task.title: Write the Sleeper client with a site-wide rate limiter
task.description:
## Why
Sleeper limits roughly 1,000 calls a minute per address and blocks offenders. Many jobs running at once must share one budget.

## Steps
1. Port the endpoints in `rebuild/sleeper.py` to `fetch`, with the same retry and 429 back-off behaviour.
2. Add a Durable Object that hands out call permits at a configurable rate, and make every Sleeper call take one.
3. Set the starting rate from the spike's results, well under Sleeper's limit.
4. Count calls and 429 responses per job for logging.
5. Send a plain, generic `User-Agent`.

## Done when
- With several jobs running at once, total calls per minute stay under the configured rate.
- A 429 from Sleeper is retried with back-off and logged.
